title: Former Biden Chief, With Help From Alex Soros, Will Gather Aides of 2028 Hopefuls
summary: Jen O’Malley Dillon, who led the former president’s last two White House bids, is inviting top Democratic operatives to a gathering funded in part by the megadonor Alex Soros.
